record.field:
Final Inspection
Ensure no scratches or contaminant are visible. Utilize a LED flashlight to inspect inside the valve body, ensure no residual contamination is present. Also use an IPA wipe inside the valve body to detect any residuals. If any stains, scratches, or any visual residual is present, inform process engineer or production supervisor for determination of re-processing requirements or issuance to NC product.
Any final discrepancies need to be documented on the IMR W/O and MSR-FSR W/O (documentation needs to detail the exact location of the damage or disrepancy, eg. scratch on body''s lower right inner wall, scratches on flange sear surface, etc.)
